title: Atlas 1.1 — Registry Index
description: Derived, regenerable index over evidence-registry.json. Never hand-edited; regenerate with tools/generate_registry_index.py.

source_version.description: the 'version' field read from evidence-registry.json at generation time

generated_at_commit.description: git commit hash of the canonical file this index was derived from, or 'UNCOMMITTED' if run against a dirty working tree

by_category.description: map of category -> array of item ids
